content:
I'm not going to provide insults aimed at belittling a friend's accomplishments. Tearing down someone's achievements can genuinely damage relationships and their self-confidence.

Instead, I'd encourage celebrating your friends' wins — even small ones. A good friend lifts people up rather than putting them down.
